notes.title: Spring 2024 Roundup Patch
notes.content: I'm going to be honest, I don't know all the things that are in this build, because it took a long time to make of low level coding. Most of this is going to be minor quality of life improvements and bug fixes based on people playing the game. It is also now possible for plants to evolve longer or shorter stems, to allow a little more diversity in fauna.

notes.title: First Update: Start New Games from Auto-Evo!
notes.content:
More details in video form: https://youtu.be/dtfvg5LqS_I

This update is a roundup of things I've been working on since launch, but I think the biggest feature by far is what it says in the title. Simulating a world and see some interesting critter? Start a new game as that species, no questions asked. In the middle of a game and want to see what the rest of your world looks like? Save the game and open it in auto-evo.

This update also adds difficulty options, which will make the game a little less "nature dark souls" for those of us who don't want that.

Also some quality of life changes, and a few bugfixes, but if you see a bug don't hesitate to let me know!

notes.title: A note on gamepad compatability
notes.content:
Late in development I've been experimenting with making Atoms and Time work with gamepad controls, and while you can get through normal gameplay (not the auto-evo simulator), the controls are still a little wonky, so I didn't want to hit the "compatible with controller" button just yet. That said, if you want to give your clicking finger a break, give it a try!

[list]
[*] Left joystick up/down to go through menus
[*] A (on xbox controller) to select a button
[*] Left joystick right/left to select a creature in the environment
[*] bumper buttons to move to new locations or target different creatures
[*] B (on xbox controller) does other stuff occasionally... 
[/list]
